ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:0.95 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey barnacle clusters and scars) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey pigmentation) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) field across >90% of surface area. Distinct high-contrast white/grey focal points concentrated on the distal tips and scattered along the inferior lateral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 45 degrees relative to the lobe intersection, with a depth approximately 1/8th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern observed across the entirety of both trailing edges, featuring sharp peaks and shallow valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile on the distal half of both lobes, tapering into a slight concavity toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular pixel anomalies (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips and inferior-outer margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, vertically-oriented thin linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the mid-to-upper portion of the right lobe; several smaller, unaligned scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; several circular depigmented scars (white focal spots) distributed on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical accumulation of calcified material on the rightmost tip, creating a jagged, irregular silhouette compared to the smoother leading edge.
